packages.title: Production-ready 3D delivery for PROFOLIO: asset pipeline, renderer compatibility, and runtime performance
packages.summary: Evidence-based architecture guidance for WebGL/WebGPU renderer selection, Blender-to-glTF optimization and validation, R3F performance/lifecycle, Spline trade-offs, and mobile resilience.

packages.title: Premium non-3D website design: an editorial system that stays cinematic, accessible, and fast
packages.summary: Evidence-based non-3D design system guidance: luxury/editorial case patterns, token architecture, variable typography, OKLCH with contrast validation, responsive composition, glass and motion as progressive enhancements, WCAG 2.2, and media/Core Web Vitals constraints.

packages.title: A coherent motion system for PROFOLIO: choosing the right scroll engine, owning animated properties, and making motion resilient
packages.summary: Architecture decision framework for combining CSS scroll timelines, Motion, GSAP/ScrollTrigger, SVG/text animation and R3F without competing property ownership; includes reduced-motion, React cleanup, pin geometry, font/layout refresh, and performance guardrails.

packages.title: Resilient 3D runtime architecture for PROFOLIO: R3F lifecycle fixes, WebGL context recovery, and WebGPU device loss
packages.summary: Follow-up to the initial asset-pipeline report: current R3F 9.8.1/9.8.2 lifecycle fixes, v10 alpha WebGPU-first migration implications, explicit WebGL context and WebGPU device-loss recovery, renderer ownership, lazy/hidden scene lifecycle, and failure-state QA matrix.

packages.title: Prevent stale GLB loads from attaching after a route changes
packages.summary: Narrow implementation addendum: conditional request cancellation versus stale-completion guards and exclusive/shared resource ownership. No runtime testing.

packages.title: Route transitions as a motion system: React ViewTransition, browser snapshots, Motion layout, and scroll/focus continuity
packages.summary: New navigation-layer research: React 19.3 ViewTransition and React Router 8.5.1 guidance, snapshot versus live Motion layout trade-offs, shared-element identity, focus routing, scroll restoration, Back/Forward caveats, reduced-motion and progressive enhancement.

packages.title: Animated dialog exits: separate visual presence from interaction ownership
packages.summary: Narrow dialog-lifecycle addendum: retained exit DOM, modal interaction ownership, focus restoration and stale-close guards. Documentary review only; no runtime or accessibility testing.

packages.title: A portable shader and material architecture for PROFOLIO: TSL, WebGPU/WebGL backends, and the Blender-to-glTF boundary
packages.summary: New shader/material portability research: distinguishes WebGPURenderer WebGL2 backend fallback from legacy WebGLRenderer, maps TSL graph/uniform lifecycles, defines Blender 5.4 Principled BSDF to glTF PBR boundaries, checks material-extension support, and documents R3F v10 RenderPipeline/experimental compute implications.

packages.title: Browser automation: deterministic tests, MCP tools, or a browser-agent loop?
packages.summary: Three-tool shortlist comparing scripted Playwright tests, Playwright MCP and Browser Use; verified licences, version caveats, security boundaries and untested evaluation plan.

packages.title: Project labels are not authorization: scoped recall for MCP memory services
packages.summary: Why project labels and relevance filters do not establish authorization; MCP identity, object permissions, RLS exceptions, and unexecuted synthetic test contract.

packages.title: Embla or Keen for an original editorial portfolio rail?
packages.summary: Two-project carousel shortlist with verified MIT licences, maintenance dates, React declarations and v8/v9 documentation caveats. Documentary only.

packages.title: Premium controls in forced-colors mode: preserve affordance, not the palette
packages.summary: Narrow forced-colors affordance repair: native semantics, shadow/gradient loss, system-color controls and sticky-overlay focus distinction; documentary review only.

packages.title: After a successful mutation: choose freshness without confusing cache invalidation with commit
packages.summary: Narrow Next.js mutation-to-cache consistency reference: updateTag versus revalidateTag, transaction receipts and partial failure. Documentary review only.

packages.title: Smooth scroll is a cost, not a default: a native-first orchestration policy for PROFOLIO
packages.summary: Native-first scroll orchestration decision: Firefox 159 enables CSS scroll-driven animations by default; compares Lenis 1.3.27 main-thread wheel smoothing with Motion frame.setup and GSAP ticker integration, scrollerProxy requirements, nested-scroll/reduced-motion safeguards and a 12-scenario prototype matrix. Documentary only; no runtime benchmark.

packages.title: Resuming an agent is not exactly-once execution: checkpoint and effect receipts
packages.summary: Checkpoint resume/replay versus external-effect receipts, idempotency limitations and an unexecuted failure-injection contract. Documentary only.
